1 text not measured for contrast (under a blend mode or a filter other than a colour one (blur, url), over a picture the page could not photograph (out of view, or redrawn by the page), or past the 40 measured), first "Teks berbaur": check them by eye over the busiest part of what is behind

2 gradients and the page names no colour tokens (CSS custom properties) they could come from: div.band (#fde047, #1e3a8a), h1.mark > em (#f6d9c8); the count for gradients without a brand reason is 0: draw it from the brand's tokens and name the reason, or use a flat colour

3 control or navigation labels carry an emoji ("🏠 Beranda", "🚀 Mulai", "💬"): the count for emoji in the interface chrome is 0; use the icon set, or the word alone; a control that is only an emoji is read by the emoji's name ("telephone receiver") and cannot take a token colour: use an icon with an aria-label

1 gradient with colours that are not among the page's colour tokens: div.typed (#f97316, #db2777); the count for gradients without a brand reason is 0: draw it from the brand's tokens and name the reason, or use a flat colour

a dashed box that says "Logo Kelasku": a stand-in set in the interface reads as unfinished; use the real file or a labeled sample asset, and for the product's own mark with no file, its name in plain text in the brand's type, listed as missing (RX-AS-11)
a letter in a tile ("K") stands in for the logo: an invented mark; use the brand's own file, or with none, the name in plain text in the brand's type and the mark listed as missing
